# Sequence 6: THANOS TURNS THE TIDE

**Duration:** 01:01:12 (1476 frames, 25 shots) · **REC:** 01:05:33:12 - 01:06:35:00 · **Music:** 6M1 'Causality' (reversed orchestra > dread pulse > Thanos motif in full > low strings only)

**Purpose.** Each hero's best move fails for a reason the audience can see. Two realisations reframe the war (Tony: our strength feeds it; Batman: our perception is edited). End with the alliance on the edge of defeat, together under one shield.
